variants.purpose: balanced loss reduction while retaining more candidates
rules: skip entry when planned net structural risk exceeds 400 pips
valid EMA20 touch must occur within 12 H4 bars after clear cross confirmation
H4 close trigger must occur within 8 H4 bars after the valid touch

variants.purpose: slightly looser forward-monitoring variant; selected from entry-known density only, not outcomes
rules: valid EMA20 touch must occur within 14 H4 bars after clear cross confirmation
H4 close trigger must occur within 10 H4 bars after the valid touch
after H4 trigger, wait up to 24 hours for M5 to retest the valid-touch high/low within max($30, 0.05*H4 ATR14)
the M5 candle must close back beyond the basis level
enter at the next M5 open
keep the same structural stop and recompute RR-valid targets

variants.purpose: strict low-loss subset with longer retest window
rules: after H4 trigger, wait up to 48 hours for M5 to retest the valid-touch high/low within max($30, 0.05*H4 ATR14)
the M5 candle must close back beyond the basis level
enter at the next M5 open
keep the same structural stop and recompute RR-valid targets
